senses.gloss:
यावदर्थ यावदर्थ, i. e. यावन्त्-,
 I. adj. as much as may be useful, Man. 2, 182.
 II. adv. थम्, as much as may be useful, ib. 2, 51.
यव- + क्षार यव- + क्षार, m. saltpetre.
यवन- + प्रिय यवन- + प्रिय, m. black pepper. []
यव- + मध्यम यव- + मध्यम, a kind of penance, Man. 11, 217.

यव यव, m.
 1. Barley, Hordeum hexastichon, Pañc. 224, 4.
 2. The measure of a barleycorn, equal to six mustard seeds.
 3. A natural line across the thumb, supposed to indicate good fortune.
 4. Velocity (vb. जू).
 --Comp.
 --Cf. ζεά, ζειά, εἴα.

याव याव,
 I. यव + अ, adj. Relating to barley.
 II. m. Lac, the red animal dye.
यवक यव + क, m. Barley.

यावक याव + क, m.
 1. Half ripe barley.
 2. Barley-gruel. Man. 11, 125.
 3. Lac.
 --Comp.
यवक्य यवक्य, i. e. यवक + य, adj. Fit for producing barley.
यवज यव-ज, m. Saltpetre.

यवन यवन,
 I. adj. Swift (vb. जू).
 II. m.
 1. The name of a country.
 2. The name of a people (originally Greek, Ionian), Man. 10, 44.
 3. (vb. जू), Velocity.
 4. A swift horse.
 III. f. नी, A Yavana woman, Vikr. 77, 5.
 --Comp.
यवान यवान (vb. जू), adj. Swift.

यावन यावन, i. e. यवन + अ,
 I. adj. Relating to the Yavanas.
 II. n. Incense.
यवनिका यवनिका, i. e. यवन + क, f. A curtain, Bhartṛ. 3, 51.
यवनेष्ट यवनेष्ट, i. e. यवन-इष्ट (vb. इष्), n. Lead.
यवमय यव + मय, adj., f. यी, Made of or from barley.
यवस यव + स, m. Pasture grass, Pañc. 182, 13.

यावस यावस, i. e. यवस + अ, m. (n., Hit. iii. d. 53).
 1. A heap of grass.
 2. Provision, Hit. iii. d. 53.
यवागू यवागू (from यव, and गु for गो), f. Rice-gruel, Man. 11, 106; 6, 20.
यविष्ठ यविष्ठ, यवीयंस् यवीयंस्, see युवन्.

यव्य यव्य, i. e. यव + य,
 I. adj. Fit for producing barley.
 II. m. A month.
यावज्जीवम् यवज्जीवम्, i. e. यावन्त्-जीव + म्, adv. All one's life, Pañc. pr. d. 4.

यावतिथ यावतिथ (an old superl. of यावन्त्), adj.
 1. That which is as far as.
 2. In how many soever degrees advanced, Man. 1, 20.
यावदायुस् यावदायुस्, i. e. यावन्त्-आयुस्, adv. All one's life, Vikr. 87, 3.

यावन्त् यावन्त्, i. e. यद् + वन्त्,
 I. adj., f. वती, As much, as many, Hit. iv. d. 69; how much, Rājat. 5, 110; how many, Bhāg. P. 4, 25, 12.
 II. वत्, acc. sing. n. adv.
 1. As much as, as far as, Johns. Sel. 33, 66.
 2. As many as.
 3. As long as, Pañc. iii. d. 94; with preceding acc. of a word signifying a division of time, During; e. g. सकलां रात्रिं यावत्, During the whole night, Pañc. 117, 8; वर्षम्, During a year, Pañc. ii. d. 66; with following न, Before, Vikr. 61, 10; Pañc. 61, 3.
 4. Meanwhile, Śāk. 18, 22; Vikr. 3, 12.
 5. As far as, unto, until, Rām. 3, 49, 13; with preceding acc., Hit. 111, 18; Pañc. 87, 20; cf. i. d. 132; even, 31, 17.
 6. When. Hit. 85, 9 (with following तावत्, Then), Pañc. 48, 24; if, Pañc. 62, 1.
 7. In order that, Vikr. d. 13; that, Chr. 18, 34.
 8. With a verb it often expresses one's will; e. g. यावत् प्रतिपालयामि, I will wait, Vikr. 38, 5.
 9. Often former part of comp. adverbs; e. g. यावज्जीवम्, q. cf.
